hero.title: Careem × Navier — own the water surface across MENA
hero.subtitle: Careem already owns the street in the Gulf, KSA and Egypt. The water is the one transport surface no one has claimed.
hero.what_we_do_together: We launch a Careem-branded foiling water tier across MENA's densest waterfronts and busiest Gulf corridors — booked in-app, premium-priced, first-to-market. Navier brings the software-defined hydrofoiling fleet and the network playbook now proven in the Maldives; Careem brings the demand, the app and the three anchor markets it already dominates. Together we turn congested roads and slow Gulf crossings into fast, smooth, on-demand water trips.

why_now: Foiling lifts the hull clear of the water: faster, dramatically more efficient per passenger-mile, smooth and near-silent, hybrid-capable with no charging-infrastructure dependency. Dubai's roads are gridlocked while its water sits empty; the Gulf's city-pairs are a short hybrid hop apart. A ~100-vessel network is already ramping in the Maldives (Bloomberg/WSJ, 2026). The category is claimed market-by-market — and MENA's waterfronts are next.

phases.label: Phase 1 — Dubai beachhead
featured_routes: Dubai Marina ↔ Palm ↔ Dubai Harbour — all-electric inner network
Dubai Creek premium hop — fast, zero-emission
phases.narrative: We launch with five Pioneer II vessels on Dubai's highest-demand inner-water corridors — proving the in-app water tier in MENA's flagship city, on sheltered waters that are ideal first-of-class conditions, without touching the protected abra trade.

phases.label: Phase 2 — Full UAE + the Gulf corridor
featured_routes: Dubai ↔ Abu Dhabi — long-haul Gulf express (Quanta-LR)
Dubai full inner mesh — Marina · Palm · Harbour · Creek · Islands
Abu Dhabi Corniche ↔ Yas ↔ Saadiyat — island network
phases.narrative: We scale the fleet and open the corridor that road can't win: Dubai to Abu Dhabi as a single smooth hybrid leg, plus the full inner networks of both emirates. This is where cross-city demand and premium unit economics compound.

phases.label: Phase 3 — KSA + Egypt: Careem's other heartlands
featured_routes: Jeddah ↔ Red Sea coast — KSA waterfront network
Sharm El Sheikh ↔ Red Sea Riviera — Sinai + Hurghada coast
phases.narrative: With the UAE proven, we replicate the playbook in Careem's two other anchor markets: Jeddah and the Saudi Red Sea coast, and Egypt's Sharm El Sheikh / Red Sea Riviera. Three countries, one app, one MENA-wide water network.

close.title: One app. One MENA-wide water network. First to claim it.
close.body: Dubai proves it, the Gulf corridor scales it, and KSA + Egypt make it regional. From there the same playbook extends across every coastal market Careem already serves — the water layer of MENA's super-app.
